environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind a standard ALB with no WAF association. The application runs as the ec2-user with write access to /tmp and the application directory. No additional input validation middleware is configured. The ALB performs only basic HTTP health checks and TLS termination.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no WAF attached
config.iam_role: ec2-docprocessing-role with S3 and CloudWatch access
config.filesystem_permissions: ec2-user owns /tmp/docprocessing, app runs as ec2-user
config.network: VPC public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
